levels.surface: علي بن أحمد بن عبد الله بن أبي عبد الله البرقي
أبو جعفر محمد بن علي الباقر

notes: «عن جده أحمد بن أبي عبد الله» is one link named by its name (rule 7); «أبيه» is a bare relation.
The Imam Abu Ja'far (al-Baqir) speaks inside the story, after the narrator al-Sadiq: he is the last link (owner ruling 5).
The man who speaks with him is unnamed and the Khidr identity is not decided here. The compiler's remark about another version (with علي بن الحسين) is not a route.
